name: lesson-outline
title: Lesson Outline
description: Browse lessons and resume a course.
usage: <LessonOutline title="React" currentId="state" items={[{ id: "state", title: "State", href: "/lessons/state" }]} />
useCases: Returning to a course, a student sees the current lesson in the outline and resumes it with the continue button.
Before a class, a participant reviews the topic sequence and follows the link to a particular lesson.
task: Browse lessons and resume a course.
behavior: Supply currentId and lessons with IDs. onResume receives the lesson ID to open in the app.
